findings.finding: P3-03 and P3-06 are semantic repeats of the same dual-sourcing decision.
findings.evidence: Both questions ask whether Northstar should establish a dual-source arrangement for circuit boards for the same winter peak, using the same supplier comparison, cash constraint, uncertainty in estimates, reliability concerns and conditional recommendation. P3-03 foregrounds decision-tree estimates, while P3-06 foregrounds inventory and supply-chain effects, but both require substantially the same option comparison and judgement.
findings.proposed_fix: Retain P3-03 as the decision-tree evaluation. Replace P3-06 with an inventory-control evaluation that focuses on buffer stock, reorder timing, lead-time exposure and cash without asking again whether to dual source, or use a different Northstar operational decision.
